texts: Fifteen free 3D tools for Claude Code and any MCP client, from one address

Add one address to Claude Code or any MCP client and the assistant gets fifteen free 3D tools, with no account or key: text or an image to a textured model, rigged avatars, rigging, refinement, a search of the free asset catalog, a persistent agent body that speaks, and look_at_model, which renders a model so the assistant can check its own work. The write-up includes a real session against the server.

issues.problem: The head post compresses fifteen tools into one long comma list, so the individual capabilities blur together slightly for a first-time reader.
issues.fix: Optional: split the list with semicolons, e.g. "text or an image to a textured model; rigged avatars; rigging; refinement; a search of the free asset catalog; a persistent agent body that speaks; and look_at_model, which renders a model so the assistant can check its own work."

altText: A vintage film camera rendered in the browser 3D viewer against a dark background, seen from the front three-quarter angle with its three-lens turret, speed dial and textured olive body; it is the CC0 catalog model the look_at_model tool rendered in the session the article walks through, one of the fifteen free tools on the server

editor.summary: Every claim in the post and article matches a passing verification, including the live probes of the keyless server and the 18,682-triangle camera reading, and the cover image matches the described session. Voice, professionalism, and the alt text all conform to the contract; the only nit is a slightly dense comma list in the summary, which is not worth holding the post.
